## Excluded Elements (By Design)

The following non-user-facing content was intentionally excluded:

| Category | Examples | Reason |
|----------|----------|--------|
| Navigation | Menus, breadcrumbs, sidebars | UI scaffolding, not content |
| Styling | CSS classes, color values | Formatting, not content |
| Scripts | JavaScript functions, event handlers | Implementation details |
| Analytics | Tracking codes, analytics tags | Privacy, not user content |
| Icons | SVG markup, icon data | Visual only, no text value |
| Forms | Input types, form structure | UI, not content |
| Social Links | Footer links, social icons | Navigation UI |

## Technical Specifications

### Output Files

**1. `site.json` (Full Pages)**
- 7 page documents
- Each contains: url, title, content, wordCount
- Format: Valid JSON array
- Size: ~350 KB

**2. `chunks.json` (Indexed Chunks)**
- 66 content chunks
- Each contains: id, url, title, content, wordCount
- Format: Valid JSON array
- Size: ~210 KB
- Optimized for search and embedding

### Search Implementation

**Method:** Keyword-based relevance scoring
**Algorithm:** 
- Word tokenization (terms > 2 chars)
- Frequency-based scoring (10 points per match)
- Title boost (5 additional points if in title)
- Result ranking by total score

**Complexity:** O(n) per query where n = number of chunks
**Performance:** Sub-100ms response for typical queries
